SA No.83 of 2025
Hon’ble Siddhartha Sah, J.
Mr. Prince Chauhan, Advocate for the 
appellants.
Mr. Mohd. Shafy, Advocate for the 
respondent no.1.
Learned counsel for the respondents 
has requested that the Registry may be 
directed to prepare the paper book to which 
counsel for the respondents does not oppose 
the said prayer.
His prayer is accepted.
Registry is directed to prepare the 
paper book and supply a copy thereof to the 
counsel for the parties on payment of usual 
charges.
Today, appeal is listed on Urgency 
Application which has been filed on behalf of 
respondent no.1 on the premise that it is 
unlisted matter and there is no date fixed.
On the urgency shown by the counsel 
for the respondent no.1, list for hearing on 
03.07.2026.
Urgency Application (IA No.2 of 2025) 
stands disposed of accordingly.
